steps.content: Where are you? Why are you here? Who is Graves, and what connection does she have to you? Your head feels foggy and heavy, as if weighed down by some invisible force. The world around you is blurry and unfamiliar. You strain to remember, but your memory yields nothing.

Yet there's something about you that suggests experience with unusual situations. Despite the memory loss and the confinement, you feel no panic. Your heartbeat and breathing remain even and steady. With surprising composure, you trace words in the dust with your finger, piecing together your thoughts and trying to make sense of it all.
Situation A: "Reborn as the Vampire Lord" Betrayed by villains and trapped here, I rise from my coffin reborn. This time I shall reclaim everything that is rightfully mine!

Situation B: "I Lost My Memories and Ended Up in a Strange Castle?!" A truck drove by, the world suddenly collapsed, and I was swept into a vortex of space and time by mysterious forces. Now I must fulfill my destiny as the hero who will save the world!
Situation C: ...
A flicker of another possibility stirs in your mind, but it remains hazy, refusing to take shape. You attempt to grasp these fragmented pieces, but they drift like fog, impossible to pin down.
You can only catch a few key fragments:
Ghost bride, wishes, wedding...

Judging by the moonlight's shift across the floor, you've been left stranded here for nearly an hour. You move slightly, trying not to look so much like a forgotten statue left to gather dust. Unfortunately, besides the occasional breeze that almost scatters your notes written in dust, nothing around you has changed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you can remember how to get out of a coffin, you can certainly find a way out of this castle.
You steel your resolve and turn your attention to the only source of information available—your place of rebirth.

Sometimes the most unlikely actions bring unexpected breakthroughs—perhaps you'll wake from a nap with your memory restored. Whatever the case, your "pre-death" self certainly was a person of action; you climb back into the coffin even before you've finished the thought.

This small rectangular box provides an unexpected sense of comfort and safety, as though you're being swaddled like a baby. But after fifteen minutes of lying there, sleep remains elusive, and your mind stays blank, offering no new insights.
The same familiar, homey feeling settles over you, yet you're surrounded by a suffocating silence. Your efforts remain fruitless.

The whispers from your dream, the inscription on the coffin, that haunting ghost story you can't forget... All these tangled thoughts scatter your attention, leaving you more wide awake the longer you lie there.
...Clack!

You've barely moved when that familiar yet unsettling sound reaches your ears, stopping you cold.
It's footsteps. Each step grinds against the dust, drawing nearer and nearer to where you are.

options: Lie down and pretend to sleep

steps.content: Slowly and carefully, you lie back down, feigning sleep with your eyes half-closed, but the footsteps draw ever closer. Then, a cold breath brushes against your face—
You hold your breath, trying to pinpoint the sound's direction. When you turn around—
There's no one there. No footprints in the dust on the floor, not even a speck of disturbed dust floating in the air. You're certain you didn't imagine those sounds...
Awake so soon? Forgive my absence... my love.
